name: 3D Tibi anatomical acceptance tests (scripts/anatomy3d-check.js)
purpose: Checks the unified body without rendering: watertight single-component skin, nothing protrudes, layer order along each cut axis, mask coverage and soft edges, highlight registration across five poses, deformation, colour language.

compatibility.runtime: python3.12 or node; ffmpeg where noted
compatibility.notes: Heavy browser steps take the host render lock.

security.notes: Writes only under qa/ or the named output directory.

approval_evidence: tests/test-anatomy3d.py (2026-11-13): passes for both bodies and fails on a protruding muscle and a hard-edged mask.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.
